## Load data and packages 
```{r}
library(sfarrow)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(tigris)

birds_joined <- st_read_parquet(here('data', 'data_processed', 'birds_joined.parquet'))
```

## Observations by year

```{r}
# Where the data are, when, habitat and Gap? 

ggplot(birds_joined, aes(x = year_collected, y = sum(observation_count, na.rm = TRUE)))+
  geom_col()+
  theme_linedraw()+
  labs(y = 'Observations', 
       x = 'Year', 
       title = 'Observations by Year')
```

Observations by year with density and area search/ point count 

```{r}
ggplot(birds_joined, aes(x = year_collected, y = sum(observation_count, na.rm = TRUE)))+
  geom_area(aes(fill = survey_type), alpha = .5)+
  theme_linedraw()+
  labs(y = 'Observations', 
       x = 'Year', 
       title = 'Observations by Year',
       fill = 'Survey Type')
```


## Observations by gap status

```{r}
ggplot(birds_joined, aes(x = gap_sts, y = sum(observation_count, na.rm = TRUE)))+
  geom_col()+
  theme_linedraw()+
  labs(y = 'Observations', 
       x = 'GAP Status', 
       title = 'Observations by GAP Status')
```

## Obseevations by habitat type

```{r}
birds_sum <- birds_joined %>% 
  group_by(gap_sts, habitat_type) %>% 
  summarize(observations = sum(observation_count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
 arrange(desc(observations)) 

birds_sum %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  filter(!habitat_type %in% NA) %>% 
  group_by(habitat_type) %>% 
  summarise(total_obs = sum(observations)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(total_obs)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = total_obs, x = reorder(habitat_type, total_obs))) +
   geom_col(fill = 'lightblue',
            color = 'black')+
  labs(y = 'Observations',
       x = 'Vegetation Type')+
  coord_flip()+
  theme_minimal()
```

## Observations by county 
```{r}
counties <- st_read(here::here('data','tl_2025_us_county', 
                               'tl_2025_us_county.shp')) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  filter(statefp == '06') %>% 
  mutate(area = (aland+awater)* 1e-6) %>% 
  select(namelsad, area) %>% 
  st_transform(crs(birds_joined))

point_area_obs <- test %>% 
  select(observation_count) 
  

point_area_county <- st_join(counties, point_area_obs) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  group_by(namelsad) %>% 
  summarize(total_observations = sum(observation_count))


point_area_county$total_observations[is.na(point_area_county$total_observations)] <-  0

county_obs <- left_join(counties, point_area_county,
                        by = 'namelsad')

county_obs <- county_obs %>% 
  group_by(namelsad) %>% 
  summarize(density = total_observations/area,
            total_obs = total_observations)

bluegreen <- colorRampPalette(colors = c('#4595D1', '#73B843'), bias = .5, space = 'Lab')

ggplot(county_obs)+
  geom_sf(aes(fill = density))+
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = bluegreen(100))+
  theme_void()+
  labs(fill = expression(frac('Observations','County Area ')),
       title = 'Observations by County Area')
```

```{r}
other_names <- county_obs %>% 
  filter(total_obs == 0) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  pull(namelsad)

county_obs_corrected <- county_obs %>% 
  filter(total_obs>0)

county_obs_corrected %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  arrange(desc(density))%>%
  rename('County Name' = namelsad,
         'Density' = density,
         'Total Observations' = total_obs) %>% 
  kable(format = "html", digits = 3, longtable = TRUE) %>% 
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center",
    font_size = 14
  ) %>% 
  footnote(general = paste("Dropped:", 
                           paste(other_names, collapse = ", "), 
                           'due to lack of observations')) %>% 
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, color = "black", background = "#4392CE") %>%
  row_spec(seq(1, nrow(county_obs_corrected), 2), 
           color = "black", 
           background = "#74B444") %>%
  row_spec(seq(2, nrow(county_obs_corrected), 2), color = "black", background = "#A8D175")%>%
  save_kable(here::here('Outputs', 'figures', "county_density_table.png"), zoom = 4)
```
